blocks.x: Dave, a couple things that Ken’s pointed out to me that we didn’t cover. Could you give me the full names of both your parents?
My father, Howard Peter Brubeck. My mother . . .
Did he go by the name Pete?
But Peter was his middle name.
Elizabeth Ivy Brubeck, and sometimes Elizabeth Johanna Ivy Brubeck.
Another question about your mother: when she came back from England, what did she do in music after that? Was it primarily as a teacher?

Teacher, living in her original home in Concord, California. She had a studio built right into the home that was beautiful. You could have recitals there, which she always did. It was a very pleasant room.
Did she have much chance to perform when she came back?

People – singers would ask her to accompany them. She did a good job. Then the choir she had every Thursday night rehearsal and Sunday in the church. That was her main way of playing outside of teaching.
